title: Garden Defense
pitch: Defend a garden path from toy pests using three complementary towers and clear upgrade choices.
capabilities: Rive advisor plus explicit UI state
rules: Fixed path, no player path blocking. Towers: rapid, splash and slow; upgrades have visible cost/effect.
A wave starts only on player confirmation. Pause-to-build is allowed. Health reaches zero = defeat; complete all waves = win.
Target ties break by stable enemy id; damage and economy changes are transactional.
content: Three maps, ten waves per map, three towers with two upgrades each and two difficulty presets.
state: active wave snapshot if saved mid-wave
